raw.details:
Craft N Code – Madhya Pradesh State Qualifier:
 
Eligibility:
  • This State Round is exclusively for students studying in colleges across Madhya Pradesh.
  • Please register only if your institution is located in Madhya Pradesh.
About The Event:
  • Get ready to showcase your innovation, creativity, and coding skills at the Craft N Code Madhya Pradesh State Qualifier, organized by IIIT Bhubaneswar.
  • This qualifier provides an opportunity for Madhya Pradesh's talented student innovators to showcase their skills and compete for a chance to advance to the Craft N Code National Hackathon, hosted by IIIT Bhubaneswar.
  • The Madhya Pradesh State Qualifier will follow a structured evaluation process where teams will get the opportunity to:
    • Understand the challenge
    • Brainstorm innovative ideas
    • Develop technology-driven solutions
    • Present their projects
  • Participants will be evaluated on:
    • Problem-solving approach
    • Innovation
    • Technical implementation
    • Creativity
    • Presentation
    • Overall impact of their solutions
Important Dates:
  • Registration Deadline: 30th December 2026
  • Submission Window: 27 November – 31st December 2026
About Craft N Code:
  • Craft N Code is more than just a coding competition; it is a platform for solving real-world problems through technology, collaboration, creativity, and innovation.
  • Participants will get the opportunity to transform their ideas into practical solutions while working alongside talented students and developers from across Madhya Pradesh.
Tracks For The Prelims:- HealthTech:
  • Build solutions that improve access, quality, or efficiency of healthcare.
  • Think about diagnostics, telemedicine platforms, mental health tools, patient record management, wearable-driven health monitoring, etc.
- EdTech:
  • Create tools that make learning more personalized, accessible, or effective.
  • This spans adaptive learning platforms, skill-gap assessment tools, accessibility aids for differently-abled learners, solutions for low-resource/rural education, etc.
- Cybersecurity & Privacy:
  • Tackle problems around securing systems, data, and identities.
  • Ideas can include threat/anomaly detection, secure authentication mechanisms, privacy-preserving data sharing, tools that help everyday users protect themselves online, etc.
- Mobility & Transportation:
  • Solve for movement of people or goods; traffic optimization, EV charging infrastructure, public transit efficiency, logistics/fleet management, road safety, etc.
- AgriTech & Food Security:
  • Address challenges across the farm-to-table chain: crop health monitoring, yield prediction, supply chain traceability, market access for farmers, food waste reduction, etc.
- Open Innovation:
  • No fixed domain – bring any technically sound idea that solves a genuine problem, even outside the five tracks above.
  • This is the track for interdisciplinary or unconventional ideas.
If you're ready to challenge yourself, build innovative solutions, and showcase your technical skills, this is your opportunity to step forward. Let's innovate. Let's build. Let's Craft N Code.
